text:
Type: eyelet curtains, pair
Use: dressing a window, filtering daylight, adding privacy; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: thick woven cotton-blend fabric, metal eyelets
Colors: light warm beige, cream, silver eyelets
Shape: two straight full-length panels hung on a rod through metal rings, deep even pleats from the eyelet heading, smooth matte surface, soft but substantial
Feel: calm, soft, warm, serene
Goes with: white or cream walls, light wood, linen sofas, natural textures; Scandinavian, Japandi or minimalist rooms

product.name: MERETE
product.description: The thick curtains darken the room and provide privacy by preventing people outside from seeing into the room.
